maddeler.e: شَلُوق or شِلُوق • (šalūq or šilūq) m
maddeler.t: From coastal African dialects, perhaps via Berber from Italian scirocco.
Apparently from Coptic ϣⲁⲗⲟⲩⲕⲓ (šalouki), ⲥⲁⲗⲟⲩⲕⲓ (salouki), from Egyptian šlq, alternative form of šrq, which also passed as شَرُّوك (šarrūk, “Schilbe”).
g: an unknown kind of river fish, perhaps Petrocephalus bane
